editorial:
Ever wish you could trade lives with your best friend? Dave is a stressed lawyer with a loving family, while Mitch is a carefree single guy who sleeps in and avoids responsibility. After a wild night, they drunkenly pee in a fountain and wish for each other’s life, then lightning strikes. The next morning, they wake up in each other’s bodies and panic. The movie keeps a silly, fast energy as they try to survive work, family, and dating without ruining everything for good.

Ryan Reynolds and Jason Bateman have great chemistry, and many body-swap jokes land often. Some scenes push the crude humor a little too far, but the heart underneath keeps it fun. If you want a light adult comedy with big laughs, this is a good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night.
endingExplained: After many close calls, Dave and Mitch finally return to the fountain and repeat their drunken wish during another lightning storm. They switch back into their own bodies and appreciate their own lives more. Dave reconnects with his wife and family, while Mitch starts growing up and taking responsibility. The final scenes show both men happier, with their friendship still strong and their lessons learned together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves body-swap comedies and raunchy humor.
